audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill/Singed/Singed/Skill/Skill/Singed/Singed in both layers, but every why-string describes the packet chart instead — whys[1] and whys[2] say levels 2-3 are Kled's only window, whys[0] and whys[4] say Singed owns level 1 and level 6.
audit.why: The mirror (singed__kled) already settled this and recorded the same chart, so both directions now agree.
audit.corrected: Singed / Kled / Kled / Skill / Singed / Skill / Singed, proposed as paired full+content rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described as 'bigger fling range, more move speed and tenacity'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Insanity Potion says only that it grants increased combat stats and makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds. The move speed and tenacity figures are not in the file and I could not verify them, but the Grievous Wounds is stated outright — and it is the interaction that matters, because Kled's whole pattern is built on remount health.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], spikes[3], whys[4] and late now name the Grievous Wounds and the flat 100s cooldown instead of unverified stat claims.

audit.whatIsWrong: Singed's abilities were on the wrong slots throughout — 'his W poison trail' (Poison Trail is Q), 'Fling you (W)' (Fling is E) — and the grounding was never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive (W, 17s at rank 1, 1000 range) grounds: while Kled stands in it he cannot re-cast Jousting to dash back out and cannot cast Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! at all. Singed's kill pattern is goo first, Fling second — a target flung INTO Mega Adhesive is rooted on landing. That is the whole matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected everywhere they appeared; the goo-then-Fling sequence and the grounding now appear in early, mid, report[5], breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1] and wants.foe[0]. Matches the mirror's wording from Singed's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Fling is 10s at rank 1 and only 125 range; Mega Adhesive is 17s at rank 1. Both give a concrete 'wait for X, then Y'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and mid now key the commit to the spent goo and the baited Fling.

edits.before: He sits in his W poison trail and out-sustains your chip while you have no level-1 poke and must protect Skaarl's health.
edits.after: He sits in Poison Trail — his Q, ticking for 13 mana a second — while you have no level-1 poke and must protect Skaarl.

edits.before: Insanity Potion's bonus move speed and tenacity beat your Q-slow and R knockback, so he flings you and walks away free.
edits.after: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so your remount sustain is cut exactly when he flings you.

edits.before: An R-active Singed outruns your dismounted form and proxies your wave — your frontloaded burst can't catch an uncatchable drain tank.
edits.after: An R-active Singed proxies your wave and out-runs your dismounted form — frontloaded burst can't catch someone who never stops to fight.

edits.before: Your re-E (E in, W-pull shots, E back) plus a Q yank is the ONE window you out-trade him before Rylai/boots make him uncatchable.
edits.after: Your re-E (E in, four W attacks, E back) plus a Bear Trap yank is the ONE window, and it closes once Mega Adhesive can ground the dash.

edits.before: His R (Insanity Potion) turns on — bigger fling range, more move speed and tenacity, so your R and Q-yank stop locking him down.
edits.after: Insanity Potion turns on at 6 — a flat 100s, boosted combat stats, and Poison Trail now applies Grievous Wounds to your remount.

edits.before: Insanity Potion Singed runs your whole team down and proxies — your frontloaded burst can't catch a 500+ move-speed drain tank.
edits.after: Insanity Potion Singed proxies and runs your team down, and Grievous Wounds on his poison caps what the remount gives back.

edits.before: Level 1 he just eats your Q with his W poison trail ticking on you — you concede it, so preserve Skaarl's health and don't walk through his goo to last-hit. Your real window is 2-3: land Q (Bear Trap) so it STICKS and yank yourself in, then E through, W-pull the shotgun shots, and re-E. If you don't open with a stuck Q he simply walks out of your E and flings you, because nothing else in your kit pins him.
edits.after: Level 1 he just eats your Q with Poison Trail ticking on you — concede it, preserve Skaarl's health, and don't stand in the trail to last-hit. Your real window is 2-3: land Bear Trap so it STICKS and yank yourself in, then E through, dump the four W attacks, and re-E. Never step into Mega Adhesive first — grounded, your Jousting cannot re-cast out and Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! will not fire at all.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you can still win a clean all-in IF your Q lands first, but the second he has Rylai's and boots the math flips — his slow plus raw move speed means your E dash and yank never connect on a full combo. At 6 his R (Insanity Potion) is the wall: extra fling range, move speed, and tenacity shrug off your Q-slow and R knockback. Don't chase him into his poison trail — that's exactly the fling-into-minions setup he wants.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you can still win a clean all-in IF Bear Trap lands first, but once he has Rylai's and boots your E dash and yank stop connecting on a full combo. His kill pattern never changes: Mega Adhesive down first, Fling second — you land in the goo, get rooted, and grounded you have no dash out. The goo is 17s at rank 1, so the moment it is spent, that is your window. Don't chase into the trail.

edits.before: This is the nightmare. A Rylai's + boots Singed with Insanity Potion running outpaces your dismounted form, flings you mid-engage, and proxies your wave so you can never set up a clean Q-yank. Your burst is frontloaded and his win condition is being uncatchable — those don't mix. If you didn't snowball lanes 2-3, group with your team, never face-tank his poison 1v1, and rely on hard CC from allies to land the catch you no longer can alone.
edits.after: This is the nightmare. A Rylai's + boots Singed with Insanity Potion up out-paces your dismounted form, flings you mid-engage, and proxies your wave so you never set up a clean yank — and his poison now carries Grievous Wounds, so the remount gives back less. Your burst is frontloaded and his win condition is being uncatchable; those don't mix. If you didn't snowball at 2-3, group, never face-tank the trail 1v1, and let allies land the catch.

edits.before: Land Q (Bear Trap) to STICK on him and reactivate the yank so he can't just walk away mid-trade
edits.after: Land Bear Trap so it sticks and yank him in before Mega Adhesive lands to ground your dash

edits.before: Fling you (W) into his poison trail and onto his minions, then walk away on raw move speed
edits.after: Drop Mega Adhesive first, then Fling you into it — the landing roots you and grounds your dash

edits.before: Proxy your wave and scale his W poison + R move speed into an uncatchable run-down monster
edits.after: Proxy your wave and scale Poison Trail plus Insanity Potion into an uncatchable run-down

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then Q-pull. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10s at rank 1 and only 125 range — bait it, then Bear Trap. - Mega Adhesive: 17s, and it grounds; wait until the goo is spent before you E in. - Your R: 140s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His flip. Bait it, then Q-pull. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 125-range flip on a 10s cooldown — bait it, then Bear Trap in.

edits.before: That is Singed's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Poison Trail costs him 13 mana a tick and costs you the entire trade for free.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Landing in Mega Adhesive roots you, and grounded your E cannot re-cast.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Bait it, then Q-pull. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds — no E re-cast, no R. Goo first, Fling second is his combo.

notes: Singed has no healing anywhere in his kit text, so the old 'out-sustains your chip' and 'drain tank' framing is not supported by the data and I removed it where I was already rewriting; it survives in report[8] ('his healing fights your pattern', justifying Executioner's Calling) which I left alone rather than guess at whether Singed players still build health/regen for it — worth a decision. Also: 'W shotgun shots' for Kled's W appears here too (Violent Tendencies, four attacks). Not asserted: whether Insanity Potion grants tenacity or move speed — not in Riot's text, so the old claim was dropped rather than restated.
